THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Cilantro-Lime Rice Bowls with Chipotle Chicken & Fire-Roasted Corn

The split isn't always the protein. Everyone eats the same chipotle chicken and fire-roasted corn — the rice finish and sauce are what change. Adult: cilantro-lime rice + Tari Verde (450 cal / 43g protein). Kid: buttery rice + toum (Tushar's build; adjust for appetite).

YIELD4 servings
TOTAL TIME10 min prep + 30 min cook (rice from scratch) — 15 min with prepared rice on hand
COOK METHODAssembly
EST. / SERVING~472 cal | ~43g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: SHARED PROTEIN + VEG. Chicken and corn are the same across all four plates — the split lives in the rice finish and sauce, not the protein.

Ingredients

SHARED COOK

  • 3 prepared servings Bone Broth Rice (from the 8-serving base recipe)
  • 18 oz fully cooked chargrilled chipotle-seasoned chicken
  • 8 oz frozen fire-roasted corn
  • 1-2 limes (for the corn seasoning and the adult rice finish)
  • Salt, to taste

Kid — Buttery Rice + Toum (Tushar's Build)

  • 1 prepared serving Bone Broth Rice (split between two trays)
  • 1 tbsp butter (divided across both rice portions)
  • 6 oz reheated chipotle chicken (3 oz per tray)
  • 4 oz cooked fire-roasted corn (2 oz per tray)
  • 1 tbsp toum or preferred mayo-based sauce (1/2 tbsp per tray in Tushar's build)

Adult — Cilantro-Lime Rice + Tari Verde

  • 2 prepared servings Bone Broth Rice (from the shared cook)
  • 1 generous handful fresh cilantro, chopped
  • Juice of 1 lime (to taste)
  • Salt, to taste
  • 12 oz reheated chipotle chicken (6 oz per adult)
  • 4 oz cooked fire-roasted corn (2 oz per adult)
  • 2 tbsp Tari Verde (1 tbsp per adult, drizzled on top)

Allergens: dairy.

AFTER THE RICE IS COOKED AND THE CHICKEN AND CORN ARE HOT. Two rice servings get cilantro + lime + salt for the adult plates. The third serving splits between two kid trays with 1 tbsp butter divided across them.

Method

Shared base

  1. 1.PREPARE THE BONE BROTH RICE. Cook a fresh batch (2 cups rice + 4 cups bone broth, 18-20 min covered on low + 10 min rest) OR reheat 3 stored servings until steaming hot.
  2. 2.REHEAT THE CHICKEN. Air fryer 10 min at the package-recommended temperature. Confirm steaming hot throughout before serving.
  3. 3.BOIL THE CORN. 5 min in salted water. Drain, then season with fresh lime juice and salt to taste.

Adult — Cilantro-Lime Rice + Tari Verde

  1. 4.TOSS ADULT RICE. Combine 2 rice servings with chopped cilantro, lime juice, and salt to taste. Toss while the rice is still warm — the aroma opens up faster.
  2. 5.PLATE ADULT. Divide the cilantro-lime rice across two plates. Add 6 oz chicken and 2 oz corn to each. Drizzle 1 tbsp Tari Verde over the top of each plate — do not mix in.

Kid — Buttery Rice + Toum (Tushar's Build) · Kid — Buttery Rice + Toum (Tushar's Build)

  1. 4.SPLIT THE KID RICE. Divide 1 rice serving across two trays. Add 1/2 tbsp butter per tray while the rice is warm; toss until melted.
  2. 5.PLATE THE KID TRAYS. Add 3 oz chicken and 2 oz corn to each tray. Drizzle 1/2 tbsp toum over the chicken in each tray. ADJUST PORTIONS FOR YOUR OWN KIDS' APPETITES.

SPLIT PLATE SERVING

Adult — Cilantro-Lime Rice + Tari Verde: Serve the adult portion as described above.

Kid — Buttery Rice + Toum (Tushar's Build): Serve the kid portion as described above.

Keys to success

  • AIR-FRYER TIME 10 MIN. Temperature = physical package label. Tushar confirmed 10 min but not the temperature; the package is the source of truth.
  • CORN: 5-MIN BOIL + LIME + SALT. Drain, season, done. Fire-roasted corn already has char — don't cook it twice.

If something fails

Chicken comes out dry: Air fryer ran hotter than the package temperature, or the pieces went in still frozen from the fridge shelf. Let the chicken come to room temp for a few minutes first, and lean toward the LOW end of the package temperature. Cover loosely for the last 2 min if it's browning too fast.

Corn is leathery / not juicy: Boiled too long OR sautéed after boiling. 5 min is the full cook — the corn is pre-charred and just needs to warm through and get lime + salt. Serve immediately.

Rice is bland: Skipped the cilantro OR added lime AFTER the rice cooled. Add cilantro + lime while the rice is still warm — the aroma opens up faster on hot rice. Salt to taste last.

Sauce pooled on the plate instead of drizzling: Poured too fast from a wide-mouth jar. Spoon the sauce into the corner of the plate and drag a small spoon or squeeze bottle across the food. 1 tbsp is a drizzle, not a puddle.

Kids won't eat the rice bowl composition: Try compartments — split the tray so rice, chicken, corn, and toum each have their own section. Kids reject mixed-composition plates more often than they reject the individual ingredients.

Not enough for hungry adults: Add a second Bone Broth Rice serving per adult plate — you'll still have leftovers from the 8-serving base. Or swap to 8 oz chicken per adult (up from 6 oz).

Only have plain rice: Works, but the adult plate drops ~9g protein without the Bone Broth Rice. Rebalance by adding 2 more oz of chicken per adult (8 oz total) to hold the 43g protein line.

Storage and reheating

Store: Cool rice, chicken, and corn promptly in shallow airtight containers and refrigerate within 2 hours. Store Tari Verde and toum separately — sauces on top only at serving time.

Reheat: Reheat rice + chicken + corn until steaming hot. Microwave with 1 tbsp water per rice serving under a damp paper towel to prevent drying. Re-drizzle fresh sauces after reheating.

Lasts: 3-4 days fridge per USDA leftovers guidance. Freeze rice + chicken portions separately for longer storage; add fresh sauces after reheating.

~472 cal | ~43g protein.

Cilantro-Lime Rice Bowls with Chipotle Chicken & Fire-Roasted Corn

The split isn't always the protein. Everyone eats the same chipotle chicken and fire-roasted corn — the rice finish and sauce are what change. Adult: cilantro-lime rice + Tari Verde (450 cal / 43g protein). Kid: buttery rice + toum (Tushar's build; adjust for appetite).

Make this when

You want one shared cook to feed adults + kids without treating them as two separate dinners. The chicken and corn stay the same across all four plates; the rice finish and the sauce are what change. Adults get cilantro-lime Bone Broth Rice with Tari Verde; kids get buttery rice with toum. Tushar cooked the rice from a full Bone Broth Rice batch (8 servings) so this dinner uses 3 and leaves 5 in the fridge for later meals — the shortcut window shrinks to ~15 min when the rice is already prepped.
